arStrings.szText:
While in Human form, every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} {c_important}Nature Magic{/c} {c_important}Critical Strikes{/c}, or {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 / (Affix."Static Value 1" + 1)]{/c} against Bosses, grant Anima of the Forest for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

Anima of the Forest grants the {c_important}Perfect Storm{/c} and {c_important}Earthen Might{/c} Key Passives.
